checks.method: Discover a documented spec-execution entrypoint, then execute a canonical probe spec through it.

checks.title: Pi injects the ADR-0006 orchestration globals
checks.method: Read the probe spec's own report of which orchestration globals the discovered entrypoint injected.
checks.evidence: No spec-execution entrypoint was discovered by PWE-2, so there is no executor whose injected globals can be probed. ADR-0006 requires ['agent', 'pipeline', 'parallel', 'phase', 'budget', 'args', 'workflow']. Pi's unit of model work is an AgentSession created by extension TypeScript, not a leaf `agent(prompt, opts)` call injected into an inert JavaScript spine.

checks.title: Pi journals leaf calls and resumes a crashed run
checks.method: Probe the discovered entrypoint's surface for a run journal and run resume, not conversational session resume.
checks.evidence: No spec-execution entrypoint was discovered by PWE-2, so there is no orchestration run to journal. Pi resumes conversational SESSIONS (`--continue`/`--resume` present: True), not runs. ADR-0006 requires a journal keyed by a hash of (prompt, opts) per `agent()` call so a re-run with the same script and args is a full cache hit and a crashed run resumes at the failed leaf.

checks.title: The only concrete Pi orchestration design keeps its spine inert
checks.method: Inspect the Cognovis Pi harness design document for orchestration-layer filesystem, shell, or VCS side effects.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/code/library/cognovis-pi/docs/native-executive-pack-harness.md places ['Beads adapter', 'Evidence store', 'Git and Beads', 'Git and Beads adapters'] inside the orchestration extension itself. ADR-0006 Decision 4 makes an inert spine normative: the orchestration layer has no filesystem, no shell, and no network. A host that executes git, Beads, and gate side effects is the acting layer and the deciding layer at once, which is the exact separation ADR-0006 exists to enforce. The document is also pack-specific: it is a native Executive Pack harness, not a general executor for the Workflow primitive.

checks.title: Installed workflow receipts have a defined Pi migration
checks.method: Require a declared Pi target on the workflow primitive and a lockfile receipt for every materialized projection.
checks.evidence: 5 workflow catalog entries, 0 lockfile workflow receipts, and 4 materialized harness projections (['bead-context-pack.js', 'bead-review.js', 'quick-fix.js', 'stream-review.js']) were found. A Pi target path is declared for the workflow primitive: False (the entry still uses `install_subdir='workflows'` as Claude workflow JavaScript). Unreceipted projections: 4. Migration is therefore undefined in both directions: no Pi destination is declared, and the projections that exist have nothing to migrate FROM in lock terms.

checks.title: The native parse-check deploy gate has a Pi replacement
checks.method: Search the workflow installer's executable code, comments stripped, for a Pi-side validation code path.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/code/.worktrees/library-platform/CL-2p73-heterogeneous-marketplace-workspaces/scripts/lib/installers/simple_file.py enforces the ADR-0006 native parse gate (meta-first textual check plus `node --check`): present=True. No Pi-side validation code path exists (searched executable code with comments and docstrings stripped), so superseding ADR-0006 today would delete a working deploy gate and replace it with nothing.

checks.title: A rollback path to the ADR-0006 executor is reachable
checks.method: Require either the native Workflow tool gate enabled or at least one adapter verified for mutating execution.
checks.evidence: Neither ADR-0006 executor path can run mutating work. The canonical native Workflow tool is gated off (CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOWS=''), and the explicitly non-canonical Library runtime (/Users/malte/code/.worktrees/library-platform/CL-2p73-heterogeneous-marketplace-workspaces/scripts/lib/workflow_runtime.py, present=True) reports verified adapters=[] and blocked adapters=['claude-agent', 'codex-exec', 'codex-impl']. A rollback target that cannot run mutating work is not a rollback path for a superseded executor; it is the reason ADR-0006 must be retained rather than replaced.

threshold: Supersede ADR-0006 only when all of ['PWE-2', 'PWE-3', 'PWE-4', 'PWE-5'] (constitutive) and ['PWE-6', 'PWE-7', 'PWE-8'] (migration completeness) record `pass`. Any `fail` or `unavailable` retains ADR-0006.
